author: chinmayshastry05-cpu
description: Agentic Browser bridge — an original, local-first MCP bridge that lets an AI agent observe, plan, and act inside a real browser session.
name: agentic-browser-bridge

scripts.agent: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js agent
scripts.serve: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js serve
scripts.mcp: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js mcp --transport
scripts.mcp-stdio: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js mcp --transport stdio
